column1: # reach-guard kit default classes, read by scripts/reach-guard.sh. TAB-separated, `#` starts a comment.
# A user layer at ${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/reach-guard/classes.tsv adds or overrides rows:
# group, target and selector rows are keyed (a user row replaces the kit row); prog, optarg, readopt and
# wrapper rows are unions, and `prog <group> <program> none` removes a kit prog row; verb and rverb rows
# are ordered lists, user rows first, first match wins; mcp rows are ordered the same way; local-origin
# rows are a union (a user row cannot remove a kit row). Agents cannot edit this file (reach-guard denies
# it); a class change is a hand edit committed through the normal kit path.
# Kinds: group <name> <on|off> <options> <summary>, options `-` or a comma list of act=deny|ask,
# grant=none|observe|all, local=yes|no (absent: act=ask, grant=none, local=no; read by the browser arm
# only, a bad value makes the row bad); prog <group> <program> <shape>;
# noexec <word list> (union): commands whose first operand is never run as a program, so an unknown
# command word is unsure only when it is not listed here and its first operand is a class program.
